bluf: Canopy Management is a US, mid market, full service Amazon agency founded in 2015. It leads with Amazon PPC and DSP, prices itself as performance based behind a free audit and a free Amazon Brand Plan, and claims $3.2B+ managed revenue, 1,000+ brands and 99.1% retention. The record lists no moves, news or jobs, so direction shows only in its AI posture: GEO research from in house citation monitoring and listings readied for Amazon's AI shopping assistant. A rival should know its sitemap shows 1 URL updated in 365 days, the Horus read marks it most exposed to KJ5 through the DSP line, and Zugu already shops with exposure-ninja.
doing:
The positioning line, a results focused, performance based full service Amazon agency also running Walmart, Chewy and Shopify growth with human experts amplified by proprietary tech, decodes as: it runs a brand's Amazon account end to end and gets paid on results. The headline claim, $3.2B+ managed revenue, 1,000+ brands scaled and a 99.1% client retention rate, is a claim; nothing in the record audits it. It also says it was named the fastest growing Amazon agency in America (undated), and its services page carries review badges, the largest showing 4.8/5 from 381 ratings.

The sold mix is 12 marketplace service lines, from full service Amazon, Walmart and Chewy management and PPC advertising through Demand-Side Platform, listing optimization, Amazon SEO and product photography to customized reporting, revenue reclaim and Google advertising. The capability read scores Retail Media 3 as the lead line (the title brands it a full service Amazon agency; an Amazon PPC page and 20+ Amazon case studies) and Programmatic & CTV 2 as core (a dedicated Amazon DSP page; DSP case studies for Survivewear, Snow Cosmetics and Keranique); every other capability scores 1 or 0 with no evidence note. Proprietary items listed: The Canopy Cadence (Research, Design & optimize, Grow & scale), proprietary data visualization for custom Amazon reporting, and in house AI answer citation monitoring. Partner listed: Amazon trusted partner certifications, tier not stated.

AI posture in plain terms: it sells human specialists over AI for PPC, publishes GEO research from its own citation monitoring and readies listings for Amazon's AI shopping assistant. Pricing signals: performance based, led by a free audit and a free Amazon Brand Plan. The record lists no moves, no news, no jobs, no offices and no owner. Conspicuously absent for a marketplace agency: no email or CRM line, no owned audience line, no paid social, and no web or Shopify build capability despite Shopify in the positioning line.
clients:
Canopy Management serves mid market brands in beauty and personal care, health and supplements, baby products, consumer electronics accessories, grocery, fitness, and toys and crafts; home market US, no offices listed.

The record holds 11 clients, all case studies, 9 with an observed need and 2 names only. The mix reads paid performance first (N2, share 0.37), then commerce and marketplaces (N7, 0.205), organic demand (N1, 0.205) and brand and creative (N3, 0.164), with web build and CRM at 0.027 each. The signals: Zugu came for brand and commerce (amazon listing optimization, premium ipad case brand); Snow Cosmetics for commerce (optimizing their listing on amazon); MaryRuth Organics for paid and organic (top of search campaigns and sponsored display ads); Updraft Ventures for paid (chaotic campaigns to making a name); Panther Prints for organic, paid and web (keyword and ad type expansion, conversion rate crisis); Bag Nation for paid and brand (dominated a hyper competitive niche without spending a fortune on ppc ads); Survivewear for commerce (won back past shoppers with amazon dsp); Keranique for paid, brand and CRM (loyalty campaigns using amazon dsp); Baldr Electronics for organic (golden nugget keywords, new ad types). Beau Lashes and Baker's Dozen are read as names only, though the Baker's Dozen slug reads increased sales by 162 while cutting acos by 80 in under 90 days.

Shared: Zugu also sits on the book of exposure-ninja.

What the base needs next: the Horus read ties it to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out), KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer) and KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two). It is likely, moderate confidence, that the paid heavy book next needs measurement and owned audience work, lines the record scores 1 and 0; the loyalty need at Keranique is the one signal.
house: Say and do: the Radar ran no house tests and flagged no gaps. The site has llms.txt and blocks no AI crawlers. Content velocity does not match its GEO research posture: the sitemap lists 493 URLs with 1 updated in 90 days and 1 in 365 days, and 4 AI URLs counted, so the publishing machine is idle. The tag stack is gtm, linkedin_insight, vwo and zoominfo; CMS WordPress with Elementor; pixels linkedin_insight; test tool vwo; ABM stack zoominfo, an odd pairing for an agency with no B2B line. Google Ads Transparency Center: active, 14 ads, 6 in the last 30 days, formats text 8, image 4, video 2, advertiser CANOPY MANAGEMENT, last shown 2026-09-27, so it runs the Google advertising it sells. LinkedIn: active, 4 company page ads, 0 thought leader ads; sample: 'Most brands don’t fail because the product isn’t good. They fail because Amazon growth isn’t executed with discipline.' Meta and TikTok: no record.
market:
The Horus read gives a tailwind index of 23.8, band Favored, verdict Favored (+24). Best placed for KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out, net 0.27) and KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer, net 0.263), driven by Data & Measurement and Retail Media against Paid Search and SEO; most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two, net -0.135), driven by Programmatic & CTV (-1). Best scenario fit: The Walled Oasis (55/100). Moves: making P5, partial on P1 (no audited AI visibility product) and P2, absent on P6, P7 and P8; P3 and P4 do not apply.

The Monsoon read gives index 42.7, band Breeze, observed, with migration and displacement both at 42.7: neither the hours nor the book reads as strongly movable. Retail Media (11) and SEO (9) carry the most movable hours; no hub office is listed, so the footprint is inferred, with a shore split of 65% South and Southeast Asia and 25% Latin America. It claims onshore delivery in its own words: in house AI answer citation monitoring.
openings: The computed openings list one item, the KJ5 exposure through Programmatic & CTV. It is likely (moderate confidence) that the DSP clients, Survivewear, Snow Cosmetics and Keranique, are the contestable accounts: the sold mix leans on the hours KJ5 removes and the read marks P7 absent, so a rival that pairs DSP with an owned audience and retention line answers the loyalty need Keranique already shows. The falsifier is an owned audience or CRM service line appearing on Canopy's pages. It is very likely (high confidence) that content velocity is the gap to lead with: 1 URL updated in 365 days against a stated posture of publishing GEO research, and P1 partial, so a rival with an audited AI visibility product and a live cadence has the number and the proof. Zugu, also on exposure-ninja's book, is contestable on the record. It is unlikely that price undercuts it, since it already sells performance based with a free audit and a free Brand Plan; the sharper pitch is to test the headline claims, $3.2B+ managed revenue, 1,000+ brands and 99.1% retention, which nothing in the record audits, and to ask why no office, owner or headcount is listed.
watch: I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures (October 2026): output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would crowd the performance pricing Canopy already leads with under KJ6.

I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt-out rates (December 2026 to January 2027): disclosed AI checkout GMV would confirm KJ4 and raise the value of its listings readied for Amazon's AI shopping assistant.
I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures (late October 2026): growth below 10% flags cannibalization, and above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1.

I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility (late October 2026): US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk its own Reddit and ChatGPT citation drop page describes.
Follow up whether the sitemap shows any URL updated after the single entry in 365 days; a resumed cadence would weaken the content velocity opening.
The next Radar compile after 2026-09-28 refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients; this dossier is only as fresh as that date.
